messages.subject: Project Quartz - licence mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Our mark-up attached. The main moves: (1) liability cap down to 100% - 125% is out of line with the milestone payments Caldera is committing; (2) minimum annual royalty reduced to 500k; and (3) the audit cost-shifting threshold raised to 7.5%. Most other clauses are agreed. Happy to have a call.

Regards,
Adam
